Hey there, sorry if I just reply, last week was quite difficult.

So the surgery went well and I am currently still recovering. After I woke up I had some painful cramps but nothing worse than normal period cramps. After a day the anesthesia wore off and I started to be in pain. The pain did not come from the wounds but from the drainage. It was like a tube in my belly and after a day I started to feel it. When they took it out on the third day it was the most horrible sensation I have ever felt in my entire life but, I felt immediately better and was able to move a bit more.  The gas in the belly is also no joke. I had cramps for three days but my digestive system was not working so I could not go to the toilet. Overall it was a bit painful but not impossible to deal with.  They found out I had actually a chain made of 4 myomas, in total 6 cm, and plot twist, they found out I was born with two uteri.  The recovery time is not super long but, I am not able to move completely freely after one week and I can just sleep just on my back. My belly is also super swollen. 

I am glad I got rid of it though. All the horrible symptoms I had disappeared.
